anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the data, not a paper describing this occlusion MEG dataset.

anchors.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
anchors.reason: MEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard specification that this MEG dataset follows, not a paper describing the occlusion dataset.

metadata.methods_description: MEG data were recorded during an occlusion task and organized in BIDS format. Behavioural event logs and stimulus position files, along with eye-tracking EDF files, are provided in sourcedata. Derivatives contain preprocessed MEG and eye-tracking epochs (eye position, pupil size) relative to stimulus onset and position changes, in CoSMoMVPA format.
